_meta.note: Captured off the wire: `mimo acp` 0.1.15 (npm @mimo-ai/cli, linux-arm64) driven over stdio by a probe client, `MIMOCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT` carrying `permission: ask`. The model was served through a loopback LiteLLM proxy (1.105.1) in front of Amazon Bedrock Claude Haiku 4.5, named to the harness as an openai-compatible provider `probe/probe-model`, so `cost` reads 0. Kiro Crew's own code built the session/new array, in an isolated home. The array is providers/mirrors/mimocode.py mimocode_projection('probe-member') of a throwaway saved member spec (tools [@probe], one stdio MCP server whose one tool, probe_codeword, returns tangerine-42), and consumed_spec_matches was true for the projection's own parse against a saved intent stamped the way a save stamps it (materialized = the spec's digest). The array carried exactly one element, `probe`. The model's call reached the spec's server: tool_call `probe_probe_codeword`, one session/request_permission, and a completed tool_call_update whose rawOutput is tangerine-42. Reductions: session, message and tool-call ids replaced with fixed synthetic values; the probe's working directory written as ~/mimo-proj; the `model` select cut to its current value; available_commands_update dropped; consecutive agent_message_chunk frames of one message folded into one frame. `agentInfo.name` is the harness's own answer: the fork still reports `OpenCode`.
